caption: The worked example run end to end: multiply the three CPTs, sum out Fear to get P(Study)=0.59 and 0.41, then sum out Study to reach P(Pass)=0.654. The two sums are the only arithmetic in the whole query.

spec.title: Variable elimination: Fear, then Study
spec.aria: A four-step flow: the joint product of the three tables, summing out Fear to give P(Study) of 0.59 and 0.41, summing out Study to give 0.531 plus 0.123, and the answer P(Pass) equals 0.654.
